scenario: LSIG.3.3 CC-2: a `gap` policy on a non-integrating aggregation (`active_fraction`) is a compile error — gap applies only to `integral`.
rules_ds:
use default

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    active: Bool mutable

series Sensor.active:
    active_fraction sliding 5_min gap hold

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
